The evolution of exceptional integrated graphics performance continues and it's with this in mind that we had to check out Apple's M5 silicon, in this case housed within the latest iPad Pro. Oliver puts the pad through its paces in a bunch of games and benchmarks, stacking up M5 against the M4 Mac Mini and the iPad 17 Pro. And finally, what of the changes to iPad Pro to make it much more of a production powerhouse?
